page.overview:
What is Kristina's Woods?

Kristina's Woods was a forest in Casindral on Dominaria's continet of Corondor where Kristina of the Woods took refuge. Home to the alliance that would defend the land against Ravidel's growing shadow. A Haven to all, this enchanted forest was declared open to all who would resist the conquerors of Corondor.
